scope: Public UI observations and authorized read-only source inspection; not backend or full accessibility certification

orynt-ai.name: ORYNT AI
orynt-ai.pitch: A working SaaS frontend concept: inspect synthetic project metrics, filter a searchable workspace and build reports from the same dataset.
orynt-ai.responsibility: VAELTX designed and developed the product website, responsive workspace, reusable UI and deterministic reporting logic.
orynt-ai.boundary: Independent concept. Fictional teams and frozen synthetic observations; no live generative AI, paying customers, authentication or subscription billing.
orynt-ai.responsive: A mobile navigation drawer, stacked controls and contained table scrolling preserve the same report choices.

paths.label: Search and filter projects
paths.instruction: Choose Operations: four projects remain. Try an unmatched search, then clear the filters.

paths.label: Inspect a project
paths.instruction: Inspect the sample project's delivery, milestones and explainable attention signals.

paths.label: Build a report
paths.instruction: Change the period and grouping. Compare the chart with its exact data table and CSV export.

captures.label: A useful filter, not a decorative control.
captures.alt: ORYNT Projects filtered to Operations, with four synthetic results

captures.label: Report controls on a real mobile viewport.
captures.alt: ORYNT mobile report builder with period, team, metric and grouping controls

captures.label: The chart and the underlying rows.
captures.alt: ORYNT 30-day report grouped by team with the exact data table

aster-form.name: ASTER & FORM
aster-form.pitch: An editorial studio website with a safe, interactive reservation walkthrough and synthetic client and studio views. Full-stack certification is pending.
aster-form.responsibility: VAELTX designed and developed the conceptual website and interface. This evidence covers only the public website and safe preview.
aster-form.boundary: Independent concept. Full-stack certification pending. No production authentication, private bookings or backend behavior is certified; technical development remains paused.
aster-form.responsive: The same service choices and explicit simulated confirmation adapt to a narrow, single-column reading order.

paths.label: Try the safe reservation preview
paths.instruction: Choose a consultation and sample time, then simulate confirmation. No appointment is created.

paths.label: Explore the client and studio concepts
paths.instruction: Switch preview tabs. All records and counts are fictional, with no account access or database writes.

captures.label: The boundary is part of the confirmation.
captures.alt: ASTER simulated confirmation explicitly stating that no appointment, email or client record was created

captures.label: The same honest outcome on mobile.
captures.alt: ASTER mobile synthetic reservation confirmation with a start-again action

captures.label: A client portal concept, clearly synthetic.
captures.alt: ASTER public preview of a fictional client portal

northstar-roofing.name: Northstar Roofing
northstar-roofing.pitch: A responsive service-business website concept with situation-led navigation, inspection context and a local-only enquiry form that demonstrates useful recovery states.
northstar-roofing.responsibility: VAELTX created the service architecture, visual system, responsive pages, situation selector and local form interactions.
northstar-roofing.boundary: Independent concept. Fictional business, service areas and illustrative imagery; no roofing service, real inspection or enquiry delivery. Form entries remain in page memory only.
northstar-roofing.responsive: Service information becomes a single reading column; the mobile menu and form retain visible labels and clear next steps.

paths.label: Compare service situations
paths.instruction: Choose a leak or storm situation and inspect the different next-step explanation.

paths.label: Try enquiry states
paths.instruction: Use sample details. Preview a failure to see answers preserved, or choose Confirmation. Nothing is sent.

paths.label: Inspect the report interface
paths.instruction: Select an inspection marker to change the illustrative observation and next question.

captures.label: Service context before the enquiry.
captures.alt: Northstar desktop homepage with homeowner-oriented service messaging and enquiry starter

captures.label: Readable service information on mobile.
captures.alt: Northstar mobile service index with responsive typography and situation-based copy

captures.label: A recoverable, explicitly simulated failure.
captures.alt: Northstar demo request form showing simulated failure with sample answers preserved

mira-atelier.name: Mira Atelier
mira-atelier.pitch: An artist-portfolio concept with an original fictional gallery, artwork details, a keyboard-operable image viewer and a separate local-only commission journey.
mira-atelier.responsibility: VAELTX created the editorial direction, gallery architecture, artwork presentation, responsive layouts and commission-form interface.
mira-atelier.boundary: Independent concept. Fictional atelier and artwork details; no real artist commissions, sale inventory or submission delivery. Screenshots are UI evidence, not commissioned illustration credentials.
mira-atelier.responsive: The artwork collection stacks vertically; commission controls keep their labels in a single-column layout.

paths.label: Browse the gallery
paths.instruction: Open an artwork to inspect its composition, concept notes and commission entry point.

paths.label: Use the artwork viewer
paths.instruction: Open the viewer with Enter, zoom the image and close with Escape. Focus returns to its trigger.

paths.label: Explore the commission form
paths.instruction: Inspect purpose, format and story fields. Sample submissions preview states locally; nothing is sent.

captures.label: A gallery with a path into each work.
captures.alt: Mira desktop gallery with three original fictional artwork studies and individual detail links

captures.label: A separate commission journey.
captures.alt: Mira mobile commission request with visible labels and a local-demo disclosure

captures.label: A focused, keyboard-operable viewer.
captures.alt: Mira artwork dialog with image, zoom and close controls

axiom-strategy.name: Axiom Strategy
axiom-strategy.pitch: A B2B advisory website concept that makes a complex offer legible through service pages, editorial hierarchy and an interactive six-stage decision framework.
axiom-strategy.responsibility: VAELTX designed and developed the service architecture, editorial visual system, capability pages and interactive decision diagram.
axiom-strategy.boundary: Independent concept. No consultants, client engagements, market figures or measured advisory outcomes. The framework explains questions; it does not make a real business recommendation.
axiom-strategy.responsive: Long B2B headings wrap within a narrow reading column, while framework controls retain their sequence and selected state.

paths.label: Inspect decision architecture
paths.instruction: Activate Evidence or Trade-offs to change the explanation; the selected stage is exposed to assistive technology.

paths.label: Read a service page
paths.instruction: Inspect the framing, method and explicit limits around the service concept.

paths.label: Explore an illustrative scenario
paths.instruction: Follow the framework into a clearly labelled hypothetical scenario, without invented results.

captures.label: An explanation that follows the selected stage.
captures.alt: Axiom decision architecture with the Evidence stage selected in its interactive framework

captures.label: A complex offer in a simple reading order.
captures.alt: Axiom mobile decision architecture service page with editorial hierarchy

captures.label: A coherent B2B first impression.
captures.alt: Authentic Axiom homepage preview with service-led editorial hierarchy

vault-tcg.name: Vault TCG
vault-tcg.pitch: A conceptual storefront with query-based search, set and condition filters, product details and a browser-local cart. No inventory, prices or payments are connected.
vault-tcg.responsibility: VAELTX designed and developed catalog discovery, fictional product presentation, responsive controls and local cart/checkout states.
vault-tcg.boundary: Independent concept. Original fictional cards, no sales or payment processing, no real stock or order creation. This is custom frontend evidence, not proof of Shopify delivery.
vault-tcg.responsive: A narrow cart stacks product information and quantity controls; catalog filters move into a mobile dialog.

paths.label: Search and filter the catalog
paths.instruction: Search a card name. Combine set and condition filters on the catalog to reveal a useful empty state.

paths.label: Choose a product condition
paths.instruction: Choose a condition and add a demo item. Different conditions remain separate cart lines.

paths.label: Review the local cart
paths.instruction: Change a line's quantity or remove it, then inspect the non-payment checkout. No purchase is made.

captures.alt: Vault mobile cart showing fictional card conditions and quantity controls
